source.description.zh-Hans: 嬉皮的书库混合国漫和韩漫，热门里既有《一人之下》，也有《剑尊归来》《某天成为魔神》这类韩国武侠条漫。
source.description.zh-Hant: 嬉皮的書庫混合中國漫畫和韓漫，熱門裡既有《一人之下》，也有《劍尊歸來》《某天成為魔神》這類韓國武俠條漫。
source.description.en: Xipi mixes Chinese and Korean webcomics. Its popular shelf includes The Outcast and Korean martial-arts series such as Return of the Mount Hua Sect and Nano Machine.
